{{Quote|The Jawa vehicle reminded me of a Silurian rodents' nest, riddled with hidden entry tubes, access hatches, and ladders.|QT-3PO|<ref name="Jawa" />}}
A '''Silurian rodent''' was a creature that lived in nests. The [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] [[QT-3PO]] compared the inside of a [[Jawa/Legends|Jawa]] [[Sandcrawler/Legends|sandcrawler]] to the inside of Silurian rodent nest.<ref name="Jawa" />
